description: Defines classes and structures for managing OS thread priorities, CPU affinity, and thread lifecycle, including unique_thread wrapper with observer pattern.

classes.name: os_thread_realtime_priority
classes.description: Represents OS thread real-time scheduling priority with methods to get/set priority levels.

classes.name: os_sched_affinity_bitmask
classes.description: Represents CPU affinity as a bitmap, with methods to manipulate and query CPU sets.

classes.name: unique_thread
classes.description: A wrapper around std::thread that ensures join on destruction and supports setting thread attributes and observers.

classes.name: unique_thread::observer
classes.description: Interface for observing thread creation and destruction events.

methods.name: max_posix_prio
methods.description: Returns maximum POSIX thread priority for SCHED_FIFO.

methods.name: min_posix_prio
methods.description: Returns minimum POSIX thread priority for SCHED_FIFO.

methods.name: no_realtime
methods.description: Returns a priority object representing non-realtime priority.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns a priority object with maximum priority.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns a priority object with minimum priority.

methods.name: operator+=
methods.description: Increases thread priority by a specified amount.

methods.name: operator+
methods.description: Returns a new priority object increased by a specified amount.

methods.name: operator-=
methods.description: Decreases thread priority by a specified amount.

methods.name: operator-
methods.description: Returns a new priority object decreased by a specified amount.

methods.name: native
methods.description: Returns the native POSIX priority value.

methods.name: native_sched_policy
methods.description: Returns the scheduling policy (SCHED_OTHER or SCHED_FIFO).

methods.name: find_lowest
methods.description: Finds the lowest enabled CPU index within a range.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Returns CPU IDs in the bitmask not present in another bitmask.

methods.name: make_thread
methods.description: Creates and starts a new thread with specified attributes.
